title: Two ballistic missiles fired from Pyongyang toward East Sea
detail: Japan's MoD and South Korea's JCS detected two ballistic missiles launched from Ryokpho district around 07:50, flying roughly 900-950 km. KCNA claimed hypersonic missiles hit targets 1,000 km away (KCNA claim).
agency: ROK Joint Chiefs of Staff / Japan Ministry of Defense
attribution: JCS, Japan MoD; weapon claims per KCNA

title: Two ballistic missiles launched near Pyongyang
detail: South Korea's JCS said two ballistic missiles were launched from near Pyongyang around 15:50, flying about 350 km toward the sea off the east coast; Japan reported an 80 km apogee.
attribution: JCS and Japan Ministry of Defence

title: About 10 ballistic missiles fired during Freedom Shield drills
detail: JCS and Japan's MoD reported about 10 ballistic missiles fired from the west coast around 13:34, flying about 340 km with 80 km apogee, during the US-ROK Freedom Shield exercise.
place: West coast (launch site not specified in source)
agency: ROK Joint Chiefs of Staff / Japan Ministry of Defence

title: SRBMs with cluster warheads fired from Sinpo
detail: Short-range ballistic missiles launched around 06:10 from the Sinpo area toward an island target about 136 km away. KCNA claimed five Hwasongpo-11-Ra missiles with cluster/mine warheads hit a target area (KCNA claim); Seoul called it a UNSC violation.
agency: ROK Ministry of National Defense; DPRK Missile Administration (per KCNA)
attribution: ROK MND, USINDOPACOM; KCNA claims attributed

title: Close-range ballistic missiles fired into Yellow Sea
detail: JCS said multiple close-range ballistic missiles and other projectiles were fired around 13:00 from Jongju toward the Yellow Sea; one flew about 80 km.

title: Destroyer Choe Hyon commissioned at Nampho
detail: State media (KCNA) reported the 5,000-ton destroyer Choe Hyon entered service at Nampho, with Kim Jong Un claiming no technological barriers to building destroyers and cruisers (KCNA claim).
attribution: KCNA as reported by USNI News

title: Seoul reports no DPRK GPS jamming near Baengnyeong in 2026
detail: An official of the Ministry of Science's Central Radio Management Service told NK News no North Korean GPS jamming had been observed near Baengnyeong Island so far in 2026, a break from past patterns.

title: Heavy rain warning for southern provinces
detail: North Korea's State Hydro-Meteorological Administration warned of 100-150 mm of rain in southern provinces overnight; KCNA said dredging and embankment work was intensified (state media claims via Yonhap).
attribution: DPRK state TV/KCNA as reported by Yonhap

title: Villages near Pyongsan uranium plant locked down over illness
detail: Daily NK source says villages near the Pyongsan uranium refinery were sealed from Jul 13 after residents showed hair loss, vomiting, skin blotches and lethargy; authorities chose lockdown over investigation. Unverified.
agency: WPK; North Hwanghae provincial committee; Ministry of Social Security

title: Two arrested in Wonsan for smishing and voice phishing
detail: Daily NK source says police (Ministry of Social Security) arrested two IT specialists in mid-July who sent fake bank/inspection texts and made fake intelligence-agency calls to extort wealthy traders in Wonsan, Sinuiju and Chongjin.
attribution: Anonymous Daily NK source (unverified; date mid-July approximate)

title: Unannounced Hwanggang Dam discharge on Imjin River
detail: South Korea's environment ministry detected by satellite around 20:47 that North Korea released water from Hwanggang Dam without notice; Seoul expressed regret and K-water opened all 7 Gunnam Dam gates.
agency: ROK Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment; Ministry of Unification

title: Imjin River flood advisory downstream of DPRK dam
detail: Han River Flood Control Office issued a flood advisory as Pilseung Bridge reached 8.1 m (above 7.5 m threshold) after heavy rain and the unannounced Hwanggang release; residents told to evacuate riversides.

title: Bank-network hacking ring busted in Pyongyang
detail: Daily NK source says the National Intelligence Agency arrested ringleaders and IT staff on Jul 12 for siphoning funds from the Central Bank and Foreign Trade Bank into shell accounts. Unverified.

title: Bank-hacking ring laundered stolen funds via crypto
detail: Per Daily NK source, the busted ring converted state trade and foreign-currency funds into cryptocurrency and used Chinese brokers to cash out in dollars and yuan. Unverified.

title: Deadly gas station explosion in Sinuiju (early June)
detail: Daily NK source says a state-run gas station blast in Nagwon-dong in early June killed more than 20 people, including passengers of a waiting shuttle bus; authorities did not publicize it.
attribution: Anonymous Daily NK source (unverified; event early June)

title: 30+ private car accidents in North Phyongan in Q2
detail: Daily NK source says more than 30 private-vehicle accidents occurred in Sinuiju and nearby counties in April-June, mostly minor, many involving newly licensed drivers; no insurance or compensation system.

title: New Pyongwon apartment evacuated over collapse risk
detail: Daily NK source says a three-storey building passing inspection in late June showed collapse signs after rains; residents were evacuated before dawn in mid-July and a construction section chief was detained.

title: Cabinet emergency meeting on heat wave
detail: Daily NK source says the Cabinet met on Aug 2 over a heat wave since June and issued 20 heat guidelines (no midday outdoor labour, shifted hours, ice water).
agency: DPRK Cabinet; Ministry of Disaster Prevention
attribution: Anonymous Daily NK source in South Pyongan (unverified)

title: SRBM fired from Wonsan, first since April
detail: One short-range ballistic missile launched around 17:00 from the Wonsan area and fell in the Sea of Japan outside Japan's EEZ, per ROK MND and Japan's defense minister; ahead of Ulchi Freedom Shield.
agency: ROK Ministry of National Defense / Japan MoD

title: Late-July floods destroy homes in Singye county
detail: NK Pro satellite imagery analysis says late-July (Jul 20-23) floods, possibly after a Wangdang No. 2 Reservoir dam break, destroyed at least 380 homes, a market, roads and bridges near a military HQ in Singye; Ichon and Phangyo also hit.

title: Remittance broker fees exceed 50% amid crackdown
detail: Daily NK sources say illegal remittance fees now exceed 50% (minimum 5,000 yuan in Hoeryong); state security agents recently arrested a long-time Sinuiju broker.

title: Party orders rebuild of northern China border blockade
detail: Daily NK source says an Aug 10 party directive ordered border guards to rebury exposed landmines, keep shoot-on-sight orders and block civilian riverbank access along the China border.
agency: Workers' Party of Korea; border guard brigades
attribution: Anonymous Daily NK source in North Hamgyong (unverified)

title: Ballistic missile flies 700+ km from Wonsan
detail: JCS and Japan's MoD said a ballistic missile launched about 06:00 from the Wonsan area flew over 700 km; described as the 11th ballistic missile test of 2026.

title: About 100 heat deaths reported to Cabinet
detail: Daily NK source says the Ministry of Disaster Prevention told the Cabinet of about 100 heat deaths and about 4,300 heat illness cases since June 1. Unverified; no official DPRK figures.

title: Warning shots after DPRK soldiers cross MDL (eastern front)
detail: Per a government source cited by Yonhap, multiple North Korean soldiers crossed the MDL on the eastern front the previous week and returned after South Korean warning shots; first such warning shots of 2026.

title: 10+ short-range missiles fired from Pyongyang area
detail: More than 10 short-range ballistic missiles, identified by Seoul as 600mm KN-25 multiple rockets, flew about 300 km east as Ulchi Freedom Shield ended; Seoul called it a UNSC violation.

title: Heat wave triggers province-wide blackout in North Hwanghae
detail: Daily NK source says overheating transformers and substation failures caused a North Hwanghae-wide blackout, even cutting power to leader monuments; police and KPA units mobilized for repairs.

title: Chongjin hospital morgue fails in power outage
detail: Daily NK source says multi-day power shortages disabled morgue refrigeration at a Chongjin hospital, which cremated a body without family consent before Aug 8.

title: Sinuiju inundated as drainage fails
detail: Daily NK source says 379 mm fell in Sinuiju on Aug 24 (Kusong 408 mm), submerging single-storey homes in Sumun, Ryonsang and Ryonha; residents evacuated to shelters. Rain figures cited from state broadcaster/Rodong Sinmun.
attribution: Daily NK source; KCBS/Rodong Sinmun for rainfall

title: Record-scale downpour over North Phyongan
detail: State media figures cited by Daily NK: 379 mm in Sinuiju and 408 mm in Kusong on Aug 24, the region's highest.
attribution: State media as cited by Daily NK

title: Sinuiju-Dandong cargo trucking halted by flooding
detail: Daily NK source says cargo trucks between Dandong and Sinuiju were halted for over 48 hours from Aug 24 as flooding hit low-lying Apkang and Yokjon areas near the trade route.

title: Domestic money-transfer brokers return in Hyesan
detail: Daily NK source says private brokers moving cash between border and interior using coded phone talk are reviving as bank distrust grows, after earlier arrests by the National Intelligence Agency.

title: Power and water cut in flooded Sinuiju neighbourhood
detail: Daily NK source says electricity and water service remained cut in Sumun neighbourhood of Sinuiju as of Aug 26 after drainage failure flooding.

title: Cabinet orders crackdown on illegal Russian fuel trade
detail: Daily NK source says a Cabinet directive dated Aug 27 orders elimination of black-market Russian fuel by year-end, with punishment and asset confiscation for implicated officials.

title: Asset confiscation threatened in fuel black-market drive
detail: Daily NK source says the Cabinet's Aug 27 directive provides for confiscating assets of officials involved in illicit Russian fuel sales and seizing diverted fuel.

title: Repeated armed MDL crossings draw more warning shots
detail: JCS confirmed North Korean troops recently violated the MDL on the eastern front again and ROK forces fired warning shots; crossings involved armed patrol units.

title: Floods and landslides hit Rason near Russia border
detail: NK Pro imagery shows 100+ flooded homes in Kwangok-dong, landslides on roads and rail, and damaged bridges in Rason on Aug 31-Sep 1; state TV reported 266 mm of rain in a day.
attribution: NK Pro imagery; rainfall per DPRK state TV

title: Coal smuggled to China via ship-to-ship transfers off Nampo
detail: Daily NK source says over 3,000 tons of coal can be moved out in a night via ship-to-ship transfers near Nampo in breach of UN sanctions, at about 500 yuan/ton; volumes reportedly up 30-40% on last year.
attribution: Anonymous Daily NK source and Chinese traders (unverified)

title: Fake job-placement scam artist arrested in Sariwon
detail: Daily NK source says a former provincial party personnel official was arrested in mid-August for selling fake state job placements for USD 5,000-10,000+ per graduate using forged documents.

title: Second destroyer Kang Kon commissioned at Wonsan
detail: KCNA reported the 5,000-ton destroyer Kang Kon joined the East Sea Fleet; Kim Jong Un called it an offensive destroyer tied to nuclear deterrence (KCNA claim).
attribution: KCNA as reported by Korea Times

title: SRBMs and 600mm rockets fired from Wonsan
detail: JCS said multiple Hwasong-11 series missiles and 600mm rockets were fired from the Wonsan area around 05:20, flying about 250 km, a day after the Freedom Edge trilateral drill ended.

title: Coal mine shaft collapse buries three workers
detail: Daily NK source says timber supports gave way in an inclined shaft of a factory-run coal mine in North Hamgyong, burying three workers; one hospitalized with serious injuries.

title: Pork near record as African swine fever endemic
detail: Daily NK market survey puts pork at about 159,000 won/kg in August 2026, roughly 12x 2018 levels; analyst attributes it partly to endemic African swine fever since 2019.
attribution: Daily NK price survey; Good Farmers institute analyst

title: Man arrested for drone filming inside Kaesong homes
detail: Daily NK source says Kaesong security officials arrested a farm worker in late August for filming inside homes with a crop-spraying drone; the city then put all drone use under supervision.

title: Border meth prices surge under drug crackdown
detail: Daily NK source in North Pyongan says an intensified crackdown shrank distribution networks, with a meth dose now topping 500 yuan (about USD 75), up from 100-200 yuan.

title: Two ballistic missiles fired from Wonsan within three hours
detail: JCS detected a Hwasong-11 series missile around 15:00 flying about 450 km, followed by a second flying over 600 km; Seoul and Tokyo condemned the launches.
agency: ROK Joint Chiefs of Staff / Japan MoD

title: New Yalu River Bridge opening rumoured for early October
detail: Dandong traders cited by Daily NK say DPRK customs facilities at the long-idle New Yalu River Bridge are nearly complete, with opening talk around Oct 6-10; outlet cautions past rumours proved wrong.
attribution: Border traders via Daily NK source in China
